caption: An older couple with a baby standing in front of a brick house.
description: A black and white photograph captures an older man, an older woman, and a baby standing outdoors in front of a brick house. The man, wearing a suit and glasses, stands on the left, looking down at the baby. The woman, on the right, holds the baby and smiles, also looking at the child. The baby, dressed in light clothing, looks downwards. The background features a dark-colored roof overhang and a front door with multiple textured glass panes. A house number '42' is visible above the door. The overall scene suggests a family moment, possibly grandparents with a grandchild.
